newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $793 mln for Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $793 mln for Thursday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Thursday, May 29 are expected to total $793 million in 25 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $414 million in 10 sales, with a $144 million Dallas-Fort Worth, Texas, deal through Bear, Stearns & Co., Inc. topping the list.
On the competitive side, 15 sales totaling $380 million are on the schedule. A $256 million Los Angeles County MTA, Calif., deal at 1200 EDT is the largest.
An additional three sales totaling $20 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Thursday depending on market conditions.
